Kang et al. (2018) PBMC Interferon-Beta Response Analysis

GSE96583 / muscData EH2259 Paired Pseudobulk DESeq2 MSigDB Hallmark GSEA STRING PPI Network (Score ≥ 0.700)

Study Design: Recombinant IFN-β (stim) versus control (ctrl) for 6 hours across 8 systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) donors multiplexed in 10x single-cell RNA sequencing. Analysis models donor-paired condition effects (~ donor + condition), preserving independent biological replicates and eliminating single-cell pseudo-replication.

1. Cross-Cell-Type Response Dynamics

Differential expression across all major PBMC lineages reveals that myeloid populations (CD14+ Monocytes and FCGR3A+ Monocytes) exhibit the strongest transcriptional reprogramming, while T cells and NK cells exhibit focused, compact effector induction.

2. MSigDB Hallmark Pathway Enrichment (GSEA)

Pre-ranked Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) across Wald statistics from CD14+ Monocytes demonstrates top enrichment for canonical interferon signaling cascades, innate immune activation, and inflammatory signaling.

Figure 1: Normalized Enrichment Scores (NES) and -log10(FDR q-values) for top Hallmark pathways in stimulated CD14+ Monocytes. Dot size denotes the proportion of genes in each gene set contributing to the core leading-edge enrichment.

3. High-Confidence STRING Protein Interaction Network

Protein-protein physical and functional interaction network for top stimulated antiviral effectors (ISG15, IFIT1/2/3, MX1/2, OAS1/2/3, RSAD2, CXCL10, STAT1, IRF7, USP18, DDX58, EIF2AK2, BST2, XAF1, IFI44L, HERC5) queried from the STRING database at high confidence (score ≥ 0.700; 179 edges across 20 nodes).

Figure 2: STRING PPI Network of core interferon-stimulated effectors. Nodes are colored by functional cluster and sized by degree centrality; edge width represents confidence score (0.700 to 0.999).

4. Provenance, Manifest & Reproducibility

Machine-Readable Study Manifest (study_manifest.json)

A comprehensive, machine-readable study manifest is versioned at study_manifest.json. It records full dataset provenance, exact computational dependencies, statistical parameters, random number generator seeds, and cryptographic SHA-256 checksums across all study outputs.

Primary AccessionNCBI GEO GSE96583 | Bioconductor ExperimentHub EH2259 (muscData::Kang18_8vs8)
Biological Cohort8 SLE patient donors, paired 6-hour recombinant IFN-β vs. vehicle control (24,679 singlet cells, 35,635 genomic features)
Core Software & VersionsPython 3.11+, Scanpy ≥1.10, PyDESeq2 0.4.11 / Bioconductor DESeq2 ≥1.40, GSEApy 1.1.4, STRING API v12.0
Statistical ParametersPaired GLM (~ donor + condition), Wald test, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR < 0.05, |log2FC| ≥ 1.0, min 20 cells/stratum
Reproducibility SeedsFixed RNG seed 42 across Python, NumPy, GSEA permutations, and NetworkX layout
  • Dataset Accession: GSE96583, Bioconductor ExperimentHub EH2259 (muscData::Kang18_8vs8).
  • Cell QC: Singlet cells retained (multiplets removed); genes filtered at count ≥ 10 in ≥ 3 pseudobulk samples.
  • Statistical Model: Paired negative binomial GLM (~ donor + condition) with Wald test and Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction.
  • Network Architecture: STRING API v12.0 query for Homo sapiens (species 9606) at combined score threshold 700.
